Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Frames 17.0 to 17.8 s. Two frames of empty creek, then a hard cut at 17.4 s to a side view of a white car standing in brown floodwater on a street, with low beige houses, a fence, a live oak and green street signs behind it and a grey sidewalk in front. The car and water look unchanged across the three frames. Caption appears at 17.6 s.
